rationale: Standalone retail-finance daily; recurring bank product/digital-channel signals, one crawl covers publisher group.
Persistent supplier-tag index acting as a narrow recurring feed; low volume but cheap to poll.
Media-ownership watchdog: useful for source credibility scoring but not banking/payments signal itself.
Comparison portal publishing bank-by-bank rollout/ATM obligation detail — direct demand signal for self-service vendors.
Consultancy blog tracking HU core-banking transformation programme stages; analyst-grade recurring vendor intel.
Plausible banking trade magazine but access and vendor-level content depth unverified.
Consumer finance aggregator largely republishing primary outlets; redundant except as backstop.
Canonical HU credit-institution member roster; mine once to seed the banking actor map, then archive.
Working-group roster names cards/payments/cash/digitalisation agendas — leading indicator of procurement themes.
Association publications page keeps producing position papers pre-announcing sector direction; monitor continuously.
Largest HU ICT supplier directory; single best harvest for local integrators serving banks.
Dated new-member news feed giving incremental vendor visibility in the vendor's own words.
Fintech association hub publishing recurring annual ecosystem report; both actor map and trend cross-check.
VC/PE member roster identifies funders of HU fintechs; mine once for lead list.
Near-census searchable chamber registry — reusable query surface for entity resolution, not a one-off list.
County chamber company database surfaces non-Budapest IT/POS service firms; harvest once per region.
Chamber section structure page only indirectly enumerates firms; value unclear until mined.
Leasing association members plus supporting-member list exposing technology/BPO suppliers to lenders.
Factoring association roster maps receivables-finance incumbents and fintech entrants.
Digital-commerce alliance partner list documents card-scheme/e-commerce acceptance cluster.
Curated HU blockchain/DLT ecosystem map plus outward links to coalition and EDIH rosters.
Static founder-member roster PDF of the national AI Coalition; harvest names once.
One-off national fintech strategy PDF: useful policy-frame evidence, not a recurring signal producer.
Corporate/supporting membership page of the legacy ICT society; complements IVSZ on the academic-industrial side.
Retail-trade member roster maps the payment-acceptance buyer universe (POS, instant payment).
Industry-4.0 platform roster is a second-order pointer with weak financial-sector relevance.
Wikipedia entry usable only for alias/glossary normalisation of renamed or merged institutions.
